content.text: I've read the changed PersonDetail.tsx (full new version on branch `feat/web-person-page`), the reach.ts helper it now imports, and traced every new sink. **What was reviewed:** 1. **New ``** — `photoUrl` comes from `live?.photoUrl` (Convex storage). Rendered in an `` tag, which cannot execute JS from any URL scheme (`javascript:`, `data:` etc.). No XSS possible via image `src` in modern browsers. 2. **New text renders** (`detail`, `about`, `connection.state`, `person.name`, handle labels/values) — all rendered as JSX text children `{value}`, which React auto-escapes. No `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`. 3. **New handle links via `reachUrl`** — traced the source: - Known-platform URLs go through `escapeForPath` (encodeURIComponent, then puts back `$ & + , / ; = @`). All of these are safe within the URL path — `/` in path can't change the host, `@` is fine after the authority `/`, no `?` or `#` in the keep-list. - `tel:` URLs use `dialable()` which strips to digits + optional leading `+`. - `wa.me/` uses `digitsOnly()` (digits only). - Only known platforms produce URLs; unknown = `null` → ``, not ``. - `target="_blank"` links correctly get `rel="noopener noreferrer"`. 4. **Sort/preferred logic** uses `samePlatform` (case-insensitive) — no auth impact. 5. **`readFileSync("ios/…/PersonScreen.swift")` in test** — test-only, hardcoded paths, no user input. 6. **Photo `onError` fallback** — pure client state; no data leakage or gate bypass. **Not present in this diff:** no new authz checks, no server mutations added, no sinks (exec/eval/SQL/logging/fs writes), no IaC/CI changes, no allowlist edits. Backend fields (`headline`, `bio`, `city`, `connection`, `photoUrl`) are new to the Doc *type* here but their production of/authorization is outside this diff's four files. No source→sink path I can name with a plausible failure scenario.
